title: Pass arguments in order
objective: Call a function by listing its values in the order of its takes lines, joined with and.

body.text: A call can pass its values without naming them. The first value goes to the first takes line, the second value to the second takes line, and so on. Write the function name, then the values. When there are several values, join them with and. A call with one value needs no and.

body.title: One value
body.code:
function shout
    takes text called word
    say "{word}!"

shout "hi"

body.text: The order of the values matters. Each value is matched with the takes line in the same position, so swapping them changes the result.

body.title: Order decides the meaning
body.code:
function subtract
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left minus right

say subtract 10 and 3
say subtract 3 and 10

body.text: A value can also be a variable. The call uses the value the variable holds, so you can pass a name the same way you pass a number.

body.title: A variable as a value
body.code:
function subtract
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left minus right

make start equal to 5
say subtract 20 and start

body.prompt: The values in the call are in the wrong order, so the program does not compile. Make it print Ada is 30.
body.starter:
function describe
    takes text called name
    takes number called age
    say "{name} is {age}"

describe 30 and "Ada"
body.solution:
function describe
    takes text called name
    takes number called age
    say "{name} is {age}"

describe "Ada" and 30
